name: aura-clone-mern
description: Aura Space inspired MERN stack website with Tailwind CSS split into frontend, backend, and admin.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,adm -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w admin
